mapper.select: SELECT su.id, su.display_name, su.username, su.avatar, su.gender, su.department_id, su.description, su.is_builtin, su.status, (SELECT name FROM sys_department WHERE id = su.department_id) AS departmentName FROM sys_user AS su INNER JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.user_id = su.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
